title: ITimeProvider injection batch — ReplanGovernor, WorldState, WorldModel, ActionOutcome
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — merged group P1-001

Four code paths use `DateTimeOffset.UtcNow` directly instead of injected `ITimeProvider`:
1. `ReplanGovernor.cs` — 3 instances in Evaluate, _stalledAt, TryAutoRecover
2. `WorldState.cs` — IsInventoryFresh() method (Sprint 60 regression)
3. `WorldModel.cs` — Constructor, Observe, ApplyOutcome (4 instances)
4. `ActionOutcome.cs` — All 7 factory methods (Collected, Failed, Succeeded, etc.)

**Recommendation:** Inject `ITimeProvider` (default `SystemTimeProvider.Instance`) into ReplanGovernor and WorldModel constructors. Add optional `DateTimeOffset? now = null` param to WorldState.IsInventoryFresh and ActionOutcome factory methods, defaulting to `DateTimeOffset.UtcNow`.
